recommended_treatment: Approve snait as a reviewed noun candidate because historical and modern lexicographic form/POS evidence agree; keep current-use status unassessed because no licensed current-corpus occurrence was found.
column26: Historical 1906 evidence gives noun snait with gloss 'a strainer.' Modern English Wiktionary Khasi evidence independently supports the same headword/POS candidate. The evidence pass found no current-corpus occurrence, so absence must not be interpreted as archaic and current use must remain unassessed. Independently authored Khasi definition/example still required before final verification.
